cases.note: NFKC expands the ff, fl, ffi and ffl ligatures into ASCII letters
NFKC folds fullwidth uppercase letters, digits, dot and hyphen-minus into a clause citation
NFKC folds superscript digits 1, 2, 3 and 4 into ordinary digits attached to the letter
NFKC folds subscript digits into ordinary digits inside a single word token
NFKC folds no-break space, em space and ideographic space to ASCII spaces that separate tokens
NFKC decomposes vulgar fractions with fraction slash U+2044, which is non-word and splits numerator and denominator
NFKC decomposes Roman numeral compatibility characters into ASCII letters, which then lowercase
ASCII uppercase letters fold to lowercase without splitting camelCase words
Precomposed uppercase accented Latin letters lowercase to match their lowercase counterparts
NFKC composes uppercase ASCII letters with combining diacritics before lowercase folding
Greek uppercase letters fold to Greek lowercase letters and stay word characters
U+2010 hyphen and U+2011 non-breaking hyphen fold to ASCII hyphen before lexing a claim id
U+2012 figure dash and U+2013 en dash fold to ASCII hyphen so the source version and its extra are emitted
U+2014 em dash, U+2015 horizontal bar and U+2212 minus sign fold to ASCII hyphen in identifiers
Unicode dashes fold to ASCII hyphen in company versioned and company claim identifiers
An en dash in a clause number folds to ASCII hyphen so all ancestors and the four-digit alias are emitted
U+2211 n-ary summation and U+2213 minus-or-plus sign flank U+2212 and do not fold to hyphen
U+2016 double vertical line and U+2017 double low line are above U+2015 and separate tokens
Multiple soft hyphens U+00AD inside a word are deleted without splitting the word
An input consisting only of soft hyphens normalises to empty and yields no tokens
Soft hyphens inside a claim identifier are deleted before lexing so the claim shape still matches
Soft hyphens inside a source version identifier are deleted before lexing
Soft hyphens inside a clause number are deleted before lexing so clause extras are still produced
Soft hyphens inside a comma-formatted decimal number are deleted before lexing
Fullwidth characters, en dash, soft hyphen and minus sign all normalise together into a source version
Unicode dashes between ordinary words fold to hyphens and still separate the words because hyphens are not in the word shape
NFKC expands numero sign U+2116 to No. and trade mark sign U+2122 to TM, which then lowercase into words
NFKC folds fullwidth parentheses and hyphen-minus to ASCII so a parenthesised clause with a paragraph group is recognised
Soft hyphen deletion and non-breaking hyphen folding work together on a company versioned identifier
ASCII control whitespace and a soft hyphen produce no tokens
